title: Evaluation of African American Language Bias in Natural Language Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring performance gaps between African American Language (AAL) and White Mainstream English (WME) through two tasks: a counterpart generation task (evaluated using ROUGE, BERTScore, and human judgments for meaning, tone, and dialect match) and a masked span prediction task (evaluated using perplexity and top-5 entropy).

Assessing the representational and allocational harms toward African Americans by evaluating how models misinterpret, misrepresent, and disproportionately neutralize or flag African American Language as toxic compared to White Mainstream English.
